subject: Re: Redwood demo recap + next steps (Northstar Payments)
body:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@northstarpayments.co>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya.chen@northstarpayments.co>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Nov 7, 2025 at 4:18 PM PT
Subject: Redwood demo recap + next steps (Northstar Payments)
Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Deck_v1_trimmed.pdf

Jordan — thanks again for the time today. Great discussion.

Quick recap of what we covered / what seemed most relevant for Northstar:
- Latency + cost control at serving time (batching/caching levers, token-level breakdowns)
- Predictable throughput / isolation (Dedicated-style controls + quota/rate-limit guardrails)
- Reliability patterns (fallback routing + graceful degradation when capacity is constrained)

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (45 min) w/ Markus (cc’d) to go deeper on: capacity isolation, quotas, and fallback/routing policy options.
2) Align on a light POC plan (success criteria + eval prompts + throughput target + timeline). I can share a draft template and we can tailor it to your workloads.

Security/enterprise FAQ (short answers + links):
- https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SE/Demo+Security+FAQ

Availability-wise, does Tue 11/11 10:00–10:45a PT or Wed 11/12 1:00–1:45p PT work for the deep dive?

Attached: trimmed PDF of the deck we used (demo-safe version).

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0194


---

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@northstarpayments.co>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya.chen@northstarpayments.co>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Nov 7, 2025 at 4:41 PM PT
Subject: Re: Redwood demo recap + next steps (Northstar Payments)

Avery — thanks for sending this over.

Wed 11/12 1:00–1:45p PT works on our side.

For the deep dive, can we focus specifically on:
- how you avoid “noisy neighbor” behavior (we’ve been burned here)
- what your fallback behavior looks like in practice (e.g., same model family / region changes)
- what’s required to keep logs + audit trails for internal review

Maya will join as well.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Director, Platform Engineering | Northstar Payments


---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@northstarpayments.co>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Chen <maya.chen@northstarpayments.co>
Date: Fri, Nov 7, 2025 at 5:07 PM PT
Subject: Re: Redwood demo recap + next steps (Northstar Payments)

Jordan — confirmed for Wed 11/12 1:00–1:45p PT.

Agenda proposal (tell me if you want to reorder):
1) Capacity isolation + predictability
   - dedicated GPU pools vs shared hosted
   - quota / rate-limit strategy to prevent burst-induced throttling
   - what “noisy neighbor” looks like operationally + how we mitigate
2) Routing + fallback
   - pinning (model version + region) options
   - controlled fallback policy (same family/compat variants) and what triggers it
   - how to validate behavior (synthetic traffic + dashboards)
3) Auditability / logs
   - audit logs (who did what) vs request logs/metrics
   - retention controls + export patterns

If you can share:
- your target throughput (req/s) and typical prompt/response sizes (rough ranges are fine)
- your acceptable “degraded mode” (e.g., slightly higher latency vs strict same-region)
… I’ll tailor the examples.

Invite coming shortly from Avery.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference


---

From: Maya Chen <maya.chen@northstarpayments.co>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@northstarpayments.co>
Date: Fri, Nov 7, 2025 at 6:02 PM PT
Subject: Re: Redwood demo recap + next steps (Northstar Payments)

Markus — agenda looks good.

We’ll come prepared with:
- current prod ranges (p50/p95 latency, and payload sizes)
- rough peak TPS and concurrency targets
- internal logging requirements (what we need for audit + incident review)

See you Wed.

Maya
Maya Chen
Staff Software Engineer | Northstar Payments
